subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should provider-neutral structured questions become a permanent public Gateway and Plugin SDK contract in this release, or remain an internal runtime seam until more harnesses adopt it?
rationale: The patch is not merely UI plumbing: it establishes new authenticated RPCs, broadcasts, a presentation action, and a public plugin subpath whose long-term compatibility and ownership require explicit product/API intent.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Fix the four runtime/SDK blockers, retain the additive Gateway and SDK surfaces, and require focused compatibility tests before merge.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Remove the public Plugin SDK subpath and external contract documentation while retaining an internal runtime path for bundled channels.

options.title: Defer the provider-neutral layer
options.body: Pause this PR until Codex and Copilot bridges are ready to converge on one contract, reducing the chance of shipping an interim API.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Fix the four runtime/SDK blockers, retain the additive Gateway and SDK surfaces, and require focused compatibility tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person carried the merged Codex question slice and authored the explicit provider-neutral follow-up design, making them the strongest available owner for the boundary decision.
